targets.label: projectspec_ir_boundary
targets.description: Elicitation produces an explicit ProjectSpec intermediate representation that separates domain discovery from scaffold generation.

targets.label: multidimensional_elicitation_before_generation
targets.description: The system deliberately extracts actors/roles, entities/relationships, transactions, invariants/constraints, anti-patterns, vocabulary and voice before generation rather than generating directly from the intent paragraph.

targets.label: sharpness_is_blocking_compile_gate
targets.description: Sharpness/validity rules are enforced as blocking compile errors with explicit error codes; invalid IR is rejected rather than merely warned about or rendered anyway.

targets.label: validate_before_render_no_partial_scaffold
targets.description: The compile path validates the IR before rendering artifacts so a failing specification does not produce a partial or apparently successful scaffold.

targets.label: single_ir_drives_all_artifacts
targets.description: Generated artifacts are rendered from the same IR/source-of-truth, preserving common structural slots while domain content varies instead of independently templating unrelated files.

targets.label: anti_generic_domain_referential_constraints
targets.description: The validator operationalizes anti-generic quality through domain-referential constraints such as entity-citing anti-patterns, declarative invariants, vocabulary substitutions and domain voice rather than generic best-practice language.

targets.label: stability_measured_across_repeated_elicitation
targets.description: Reliability of LLM elicitation is measured across repeated runs using explicit stability metrics/thresholds rather than assumed from a single good-looking extraction.

targets.label: domain_fixture_separated_from_generic_compiler
targets.description: Domain-specific input/fixture knowledge is separated from generic elicitation, validation and compilation machinery so the same pipeline can operate across domains while preserving the compiler structure.
